programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Lacey and Brent help Hank build a zip-line downtown; Davis and Karen crack down on the free corner; Oscar and Emma win a free robot vacuum.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Bash's decisions lead to conflict with the new chief of emergency medicine; Mags struggles to save a patient who thinks the system gave up on her; June has trouble with her new roommate, and gets a work proposal from Novak; Theo has trouble adapting.

programs.title: Little jesus
programs.desc: Tells the story of Jean who pins his hopes of recovering from his wounds on a miracle: his ten-year-old son. He is convinced that Loulou is the new Messiah.

programs.title: The Amazing Maurice
programs.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Novel Murders
programs.desc: Antiques expert Jennifer Shannon believes two items found at the scene of a murder are actually clues straight out of famous mystery stories.

programs.title: My Penguin Friend
programs.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programs.title: PAW Patrol: The Movie
programs.desc: When their biggest rival, Humdinger, starts wreaking havoc as the mayor of Adventure City, Ryder and everyone's favorite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge. Armed with exciting new gadgets and gear, the PAW Patrol joins forces with a savvy dachshund to save the citizens of Adventure City.

programs.title: PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol pups magically gain superpowers after a meteor strikes Adventure City. However, things take a turn for the worse when Humdinger and a mad scientist steal their powers and turn themselves into supervillains. As the team springs into action to save the city, Skye soon learns that even the smallest pup can make the biggest difference.

programs.title: White Bird: A Wonder Story
programs.desc: Julian has struggled to belong ever since he was expelled from his former school for his treatment of Auggie Pullman. To transform his life, Julian's grandmother finally reveals her own story of courage. During her youth in Nazi-occupied France, a boy shelters her from mortal danger. Together, they find first love in a stunning, magical world of their own creation, while the boy's mother risks everything to keep her safe.

programs.title: The Unbreakable Boy
programs.desc: When Scott and Teresa learn that their son, Austin, is autistic and has brittle bone disease, they initially worry about his future. However, with Scott's growing faith and Austin's incredible spirit, they become unbreakable as they find joy, gratitude and courage in the most trying times.

programs.title: On the Roam
programs.desc: Jason returns to Wheels of Time with an even crazier idea: to recreate and then ride a legendary Harley-Davidson.

programs.title: Clika
programs.desc: When a clip of his performance goes viral, a small-town singer seizes the opportunity to carve out a place for himself on the music scene. Caught in a dangerous game, he must confront the choices he's made as he relentlessly pursues his dream.
